episode.showDescription: The official podcast of comedian Joe Rogan.
episode.episodeDescription: Jimmy Donaldson, better known as MrBeast, is a YouTuber, entrepreneur, and philanthropist. He is the founder of Beast Industries and Beast Philanthropy, and the creator and host of the Prime Video competition series “Beast Games.”www.beastgames.comwww.beastphilanthropy.orgwww.youtube.com/@MrBeast Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

transcript_window.text: So I was just like, screw it.
I'll just keep my lifestyle cheap so I can just reinvest it all.
And you know - God, that's so wise.
Most people don't do that.
And most people don't have the discipline to work as much as you do.
Well, yeah, and the harder part too is when you have the pressure of your parents and stuff.
And I don't know, I'm weird.
Like when my mom would, I mean, as sad as it sounds, like she would literally cry sometimes so worried you're going to lose everything.
Like, what if these videos stop getting views?
And I don't know what would come over me, but I'd be like, it'll be fine, mom.
Don't worry.
And I just like very calmly just say it to her.
I wouldn't argue with her.
I'd be like, just have faith.
Well, you were right.
I know.
We're great now.
But it's to parents.
Parents always worry about their kids.
Exactly.
So I don't think it's like she was doing anything wrong.
By all purposes, like she was doing the right thing.

It's just, so you also have to overcome that pressure as well because there's so many forces around you where even if you believe in yourself, all it takes is one person like saying something like, okay.
But that's where I'm big believer.
If you really want it, just keep your liabilities low, live below your means.
And that way it's a little easier to be riskier if you have all these things you've got to afford because what really changes if you fail?
